summary: xAI announced that its Grok 4.6 coding model is now available inside GitHub Copilot (VS Code, cloud agents, CLI) and via the SpaceXAI API console at stated per-token pricing.

mechanisms.reason: Distribution into a high-volume developer surface used by millions increases aggregate inference calls to the model.
mechanisms.quote: Grok 4.6 is now live in GitHub Copilot for the millions of developers who work in VS Code and across GitHub every day.

practices.reason: Enterprises using Copilot must enable the new model via settings and select it in the model picker before use.
practices.quote: Some businesses and enterprises will need to enable the model from Copilot settings.

practices.reason: The announcement restates Grok 4.6 as a coding model but provides no new performance figures in this document.
practices.quote: Grok 4.6, our latest coding model, is now available in GitHub Copilot.
